column3: Close to the Hebrew; “he answered me” is rendered “He heard me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “what will he give you, what will he add to you” is rendered in the passive, “What shall be given to you… done to you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I sojourn” is rendered “I dwell.”
Close to the Hebrew; רַבַּת (“long, much”) is rendered “too long.”
